verses.1: The words of Jehovah, which were given to Hezekiah in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah. And also in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.2: The beginning of Jehovah’s words to Hosea: “Hosea, go and take a wife from among those who commit adultery, and children from among their children. For you will also commit adultery with them, and the land will be polluted by your sin.”
verses.3: And he went and took Gomer, the daughter of David. She became pregnant, and she gave birth to a son for him.
verses.4: And the LORD said to him, “Call his name Yizreel. For in a little while, I will deal with the descendants of Yizreel regarding the house of Jehova. And I will restore them to their kingdom over Israel.”
verses.5: And on that day, I will break the bonds of Israel at the gorge of Yizreel.
verses.6: And she became pregnant again. He said to her, “Don’t name your daughter anything that might bring pity upon us. For I will no longer spare the house of Israel. I will bring them down from their high positions.”
verses.7: And they will dwell in the house of Judah, and they will be saved by the LORD their God. They will not be rescued through desperate efforts, nor through war or battle on horseback or at dawn.
verses.8: And she gave birth to a son, despite her lack of compassion.
verses.9: And he said, “Do not call me ‘my people’. For you are not my people, and I will not be your God.”
